name: local-files
description: Local files in allowed directories: list, stat, read (text or base64, capped), search by name or content, and staged writes that never overwrite unless a node asks; deletes are node only

nodes.title: List allowed directories
nodes.description: Lists the directories (LOCAL_FILES_ALLOWED_DIRS) this plugin may read and write, as real paths, and whether each exists

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Stat a path
nodes.description: Describes a file or directory inside the allowed directories (type, size, times, permission bits, hard links) without opening it; files with more than one hard link are refused

path.description: Absolute path, ~/..., or a path relative to the first allowed directory; must stay inside LOCAL_FILES_ALLOWED_DIRS

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Read a file
nodes.description: Reads a regular file inside the allowed directories as UTF-8 text or base64, up to max_bytes from offset; `truncated` and `next_offset` say when more remains

path.description: Absolute path, ~/..., or a path relative to the first allowed directory; must stay inside LOCAL_FILES_ALLOWED_DIRS

encoding.description: utf8 for text (refused when the bytes are not valid UTF-8), base64 for binary files

offset.description: Byte offset to start at (use next_offset from a truncated read)

max_bytes.description: Most bytes to read (default 256 KiB; never more than LOCAL_FILES_MAX_READ_BYTES)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List a directory
nodes.description: Lists a directory inside the allowed directories (name, type, size, modified time), optionally recursing up to max_depth; symlinks are shown, never followed

path.description: Directory to start in (default: the first allowed directory); must stay inside LOCAL_FILES_ALLOWED_DIRS

max_depth.description: 1 lists only the directory itself; larger values recurse

include_hidden.description: Include names starting with a dot

limit.description: Most entries to return; `truncated` says when there were more

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Search files
nodes.description: Finds files inside the allowed directories by name glob (* and ?) and/or by a plain-text substring in their content (no regular expressions); bounded by depth, entries scanned, matches per file and results

path.description: Directory to start in (default: the first allowed directory); must stay inside LOCAL_FILES_ALLOWED_DIRS

name_pattern.description: File name glob, e.g. *.md (* any characters, ? one character)

content.description: Plain text to find inside files, matched per line

case_sensitive.description: Match name_pattern and content case exactly

include_hidden.description: Search names starting with a dot too

max_depth.description: How deep to recurse (1 = only the directory itself)

max_results.description: Most matches to return; `truncated` says when the search stopped early

max_matches_per_file.description: Most matching lines reported per file; `files_with_more_matches` counts files that had more

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Write a file
nodes.description: Writes UTF-8 text or base64 bytes to a new file inside the allowed directories (staged, then published atomically). Existing files are never replaced unless a workflow node passes overwrite. Agents need LOCAL_FILES_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1

path.description: Absolute path, ~/..., or a path relative to the first allowed directory; must stay inside LOCAL_FILES_ALLOWED_DIRS

content.description: Text, or base64 when encoding is base64 (must not be empty)

overwrite.description: Replace an existing regular file (workflow nodes only)

create_parents.description: Create missing parent directories inside the allowed directories

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Delete a file or empty directory
nodes.description: Deletes one file, symlink (the link itself) or empty directory inside the allowed directories; never recursive, never an allowed directory itself (workflow nodes only)

path.description: Absolute path, ~/..., or a path relative to the first allowed directory; must stay inside LOCAL_FILES_ALLOWED_DIRS

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
